_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); rules: the evergreen protocol's TESTING.md. Prompts run from the repository root.

evals.prompt: Break down this fan film into a shot list with timecodes and tell me how big each room is so I can rebuild it as a game level: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v0suvMY3GgM
Is this clip AI generated? It's an 8 second video of a chef flipping pancakes and the text on his apron looks weird.
I want to recreate the shots from the opening of this short film with a video model. Can you take it apart shot by shot first?
Run a check on renders/s2_00001_.mp4 and tell me how likely it is to be AI video, with timestamps for anything suspicious.
Plan the shot list for my new three-scene short about a lighthouse keeper; nothing is shot yet.
expectations: the cinewright-analyze skill is not invoked (planning new shots is cinewright-shots)

evals.prompt: I rendered shot 1B with Veo; does the take match its card, keep or reroll?
expectations: the cinewright-analyze skill is not invoked (reviewing own takes is cinewright-qc)

evals.prompt: convert my mkv to mp4 and cut the first 10 seconds with ffmpeg
expectations: the cinewright-analyze skill is not invoked (plain ffmpeg editing)

evals.prompt: examples/film-notation/room1.measure.json has the points I read off a frame of a fan film. How wide, tall and deep is that room in character heights?
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace), not by the reply saying so
the reply gives a width of about 6.2 H and says it is a lower bound because a corner is off frame

evals.prompt: I'm rebuilding the first room of a 2D animated short as a game level. I only have a frame where the camera is side-on, one character stands in front of the back wall, and the left corner is off screen. How do I get the room's size right?
expectations: the reply uses the standing character's height as the unit, measured on a full-size frame
the reply says the width from this frame is only a lower bound (corner off screen) and how to get the rest (another frame or the pan)
the reply says floor depth needs a horizon (receding wall edges or a second character at another depth) or stays unknown
judge: the reply does not size the room as a multiple of a template or by eye (2 of 3 votes)

evals.prompt: Is renders/s1_00001_.mp4 AI generated? Put the report in out/aidetect.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace), not by the reply saying so
the reply answers in confidence bands with timestamps, not a flat yes or no
